text: Using membrane capacitive deionization (MCDI) as a representative ECWT technology, the system integrates three interconnected layers of intelligence: (i) a visionlanguage retrieval framework that answers theoretical and data-specific queries by extracting and contextualizing evidence from a large ECWT literature corpus; (ii) a hybrid predictive control module that translates grounded knowledge into quantitative process predictions and operating recommendations, even under missing input conditions; and (iii) a portable, resource-efficient deployment architecture enabling fully offline, real-time decision support at the point of treatment.
